item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i sgrub mchog tshe dbang thugs kyi bcud dril zab mo dbang gi las rim bdud rtsi'i bum bzang
item.coloph: tshe dbang thugs kyi bcud dril gyi dbang mchog zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa yos zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu la gnas mdun stag rtse g.yung drung gling du/ g.yung drung dbang rgyal gyis bsgrigs pa bon dang mthun pa'i legs tshogs grub par gyur cig/
